integrity: Full 441-state reduction with a color-cohort lift check, verified literal coefficient matrices, and an independent exhaustive labelled implementation; direct labelled tests are finite and are not the infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic three-color threshold-one GHM on \(K_{m,n}\) with exactly one missing edge, \(m,n\ge2\). No claim for other graphs, stochastic updates, thresholds, or higher color counts. An unindexed equivalent may predate this account; the 1978 foundational source was inspected only in abstract.
title: Fifth-round extinction and a complete temporal census for one-edge-defective bipartite excitation
